hook: Pushing WireGuard on macOS to 5 Gbit/s
hookText: Pushing WireGuard on macOS to 5 Gbit/s

beats.say: Firezone explains how it took its macOS WireGuard client from about 1 Gbit/s to over 5 Gbit/s by digging through XNU's TUN and UDP code, including batched syscalls and handling backpressure.
Firezone's macOS and iOS clients topped out around 1 Gbit/s down, with uploads often a few hundred Mbit/s, and got worse with higher latency, a sign of lost packets.
On two M1 Macs linked by Thunderbolt the client now reaches 5.87 Gbit/s up and 5.76 Gbit/s down.
